hero.title: The infrastructure for participation that creates value.
hero.subtitle: HelpLab connects citizens, businesses, and institutions to turn civic engagement into measurable data and real resources for local communities. We give structure to occasional participation.

cta.launchTitle: For public bodies, associations and companies running local activities

businessBenefits.title: One ecosystem, three actors, one shared impact

items.title: For Citizens
items.text: Your effort does not end with the day. Every action stays on record, it is validated by someone other than you, and it becomes a result you can show to the organizers and to whoever supports them.

items.title: For Businesses
items.highlight: Data that stands up to questions
items.tagline: When you are asked, you already have it
items.text: Reporting duties have been cut back, demand has not: today it is your bank, your clients and your supply chain asking where you stand. With HelpLab your contribution to the territory becomes proven data, not a statement.

items.title: For Public Administration
items.text: Activate new private resources and channel civic energy into a dynamic map of local needs. Govern your territory with objective data.

organizers.title: Running a participatory process or a local event?
organizers.subtitle: If you have a funded project, a deadline and a report to deliver, HelpLab documents what people actually do and leaves the data with you once the process is over.

items.title: Proof of what happened
items.text: Every action is recorded with place, time and photographic evidence. Whoever funded the project reads what was done, not a statement of intentions.

items.title: Checked by someone with no stake
items.text: Contributions are validated by reviewers independent from the organization, with sample checks on automatically approved ones too.

items.title: The data stays with the promoter
items.text: When the project ends the data stays with the body or association that promoted it, reusable for planning, communication and the next call for proposals.

custom.title: If what you need to measure is not there yet, we build it
custom.text: Today the platform measures mobility, waste collected, reuse and the social value of volunteering hours. Each calculation model is a separate module: when a project needs to measure something else, or a more accurate model for its own case, we define method and sources together and then bring it into the platform. The case of whoever asks becomes the tool.

cta.subject: HelpLab for a participatory process
cta.body: Describe the project, the territory and your timeline. Leave a contact so we can set up a 30-minute call.

scope.title: What HelpLab does, and what it does not do

does.title: What it does
does.text: It measures what people do, has it checked by someone with no stake in the result, and returns figures that can be reconstructed, with the sources of every factor stated.

doesnt.title: What it does not do
doesnt.text: It does not bring the people. Participation comes from the relational work of whoever organizes. Three field events told us the same thing: where the organization asks people to take part the tool works, where it is merely made available to an audience that came for something else, announcing it is not enough.

scope.note: We say it upfront: participation is built by whoever organizes. HelpLab makes it provable.

testimonials.title: An ecosystem where value generates value.

items.title: Why it works
items.quote: HelpLab is not based on goodwill alone, but on a carefully designed balance of interests. When citizens act, businesses invest, and territories improve.

items.title: No wasted effort
items.quote: Every challenge is designed to be sustainable over time, ensuring that citizens’ energy always finds technical and financial support.

items.title: Verifiable impact
items.quote: HelpLab turns small actions into verifiable data, useful for territorial planning and ESG reporting.

hero.title: Your time is valuable. Give it shape!
hero.subtitle: You don’t need to be a full-time activist to improve your neighborhood. With HelpLab, every small action becomes part of a collective challenge supported by businesses and recognized by institutions.

finalCta.title: From occasional participation to provable impact
finalCta.subtitle: Reporting is now mandatory for few companies, but the question arrives all the same: from your bank, your clients, whoever picks you as a supplier. HelpLab gives structure, data and resources to civic engagement in your territory, and leaves you the proof.

contact.label: Get started
contact.subject: Request for information about HelpLab solutions for businesses
contact.body: Please describe your organization, your sector, and leave a contact to receive a quick response.

howItWorks.title: From investment to data: what you can prove when you are asked.

steps.title: Identify impact
steps.text: Choose an existing local challenge or co-design a tailored intervention aligned with your sustainability goals.

steps.title: Activate participation
steps.text: Provide the necessary resources. HelpLab connects your investment directly to citizens’ energy.

steps.title: Receive verifiable data
steps.text: Follow progress as it happens. At the end you get figures that can be reconstructed, with independent review and the sources of every factor stated.

howItWorks.note: A document you use, not eighty pages to file away: it says what was done, who checked it, and what was not measured.

membership.title: Who does what on the platform
membership.note: Using the platform has no licence cost. Support, training and tailored reports are agreed case by case.
